stimulus_id.Description: Unique identifier of the stimulus, matching the stim-<label> entity of its files.

type.Description: Type of the stimulus, matching the suffix of the stimulus files.

URL.Description: Where the stimulus can be obtained.

license.Description: License under which the stimulus file is distributed; n/a when the file is not distributed.

partDescription.Description: How the stimulus is split into part-<label> files, when it is.
